name: robots/shupx__fastswarmsim
title: FastSwarmSim lock-step time coordinator
intro: FastSwarmSim lock-step time coordinator, adapted from shupx/fastswarmsim. It reads `clock_running`, `clock_factor`, `read_sim_clock` and `read_clock_status`; runs `pause` and `resume`. `pause`: pause clock advancement with the acknowledged fss/clock_control service. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
